notes.title: “MAGLAM LORD” Launches on Steam Today!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/2c842553aa9f53ceb061378d1fa60c8271bdbb28.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Character introduction - Lyrica
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/29357fcc801dcde40ee02d6715539c07d700d99b.png[/img]

“The Demon Lord's Friend” Lyrica
(VA: Nanami Yamashita)

A little girl living under the Administration.
She is the first human to befriend the Bladelord.

notes.title: Character introduction - Love Guru G.G.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/e5a4c84c1521df62c09e67b64482d4a342fead69.png[/img]

“KONKATSU Master” Love Guru G.G. 
(VA: Ryuzaburo Ohtomo)

A silver old fox with a burly bod, a Hawaiian shirt, and rad sunglasses.
He serves as a mentor to those who are soulstarved.

notes.title: Character introduction - Overseer Mamie
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/0bed5936deddf1991f78dc7056f8c9e804b67b3e.png[/img]

“A Hard Worker From The Government” Overseer Mamie
 (VA: Yuko Gibu)

A studious woman with distinctive glasses. 
She's an officer dispatched by the Administration to inform the Bladelord of the state of the new world.

notes.title: Character introduction - Balgackwein
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/e52bc2ea88e800b0489aa4074d340aded0bc4532.png[/img]
“The Ironlord” Balgackwein
(VA: Hiroki Goto)

The former Ironlord, who served as Bladelord Killizerk's loyal retainer.
Now he's a powerless, mysterious creature, with a surprisingly squishy body.

notes.title: Character introduction - Satyus
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/126417d3eb29f62a25df16f84995b1799083738b.png[/img]
“Demon Lord's Helperdemon” Satyus
(VA: Atsumi Tanezaki)

Balga's grandkid.
A juvenile Demon without a title.
What they lack in power they make up for in raw devotion to the Bladelord.

[previewyoutube=6L72zCKV9O0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - Acklao
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/ebaae14b026610787b3fbfecc01631ff1b019e63.png[/img]
“He Who Scoffs at Deceit” Acklao
(VA: Kenji Nojima)

Saint Acklao, a mysterious being who can grant any wish.
They say he only appears to those who really need him.
He grants wishes without requesting any payment.

[previewyoutube=2oiPi8edYTM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - Julette
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/5deb7032a35cc0375ed0b23e6c784ace3d567510.png[/img]
“The Headlong, Headstrong Beastgirl!” Julette
(VA: Misaki Watada)

A beastkin demi-human.
She is an official PR idol for the Administration.

[previewyoutube=qCt51DpUSAs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - M.O.A.V.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/da0ee4c556a8e07e85f7e75a81ba704d87b50028.png[/img]
“The Ancient Automaton ” M.O.A.V.
(VA: Kaito Ishikawa)

A lifeform created through Ars Machina.

[previewyoutube=kYws12Nja1I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - Charme
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/3661809a4b0255dcb9319f6ca18ac2f7baa2e535.png[/img]
“The Smiling Hero” Charme
(VA: Kaori Nazuka)

Darius's sister. Blessed by the God Solbraleo.
She once killed a Demon Lord in the past, and is known as the Smiling Hero.

[previewyoutube=Zt3rz-EFGLU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - Darius
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/c134570c0d850349d66d993e5731b12734a350b6.png[/img]
“Hero-to-Be” Darius
(VA: Yoshiki Nakajima)

Charme's brother.
Blessed by the God Solbraleo.
He's determined to awaken as a true Hero by defeating the Demon Lord.

[previewyoutube=ZEODwuOH9f0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Character introduction - Killizerk
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/8d82b3a3b881564962c222caf1652913844e4b5e.png[/img]
“The Bladelord” Killizerk
(VA: Ryuichi Kijima / Akari Kito)

The last Demon Lord, and the former Nemesis of all creation. 
Killizerk faced the Alliance and fell into a coma.
They enjoy sweet treats and fighting.

[previewyoutube=MsmoHQQFoIk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: “MAGLAM LORD” will be available on Steam on May 30th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319263/b1102f370ad4fb40e31a0e7d996ff08179d5db7a.jpg[/img]

“MAGLAM LORD” releases May 30th, 2022 on PC!

MAGLAM LORD is a vibrant action JRPG straight from the depths of hell!
Boasting exploration, real-time combat, weapon crafting and relationship building.
MAGLAM LORD is an unexpected combination that truly has no equal.

Only for the first week after release, you can purchase the game at a [b]20％ off[/b] price.
DLCs + Original Sound Track will be ready!
Great value bundles will also be available!
Don't miss this wonderful opportunity!
